title: A bundle still has loose ends
hook: Which layout removes the depicted free-end paths?

recall.question: You put one tie around the middle of a coiled cord and leave both ends hanging. How can it still tangle with its neighbours?
options: The tie makes the cord stiffer
Its free ends can weave through loops
Nothing can tangle once the middle is tied tight
recall.why: Bundling the middle keeps the strands together but leaves the ends free, and free ends weaving through loops are the tangle path. Securing the ends removes that path in the drawing.
